column1: # Letter classes the suffix conditions read (suffix.tsv, lexicon/suffix.rs).
# letter<TAB>class. A letter may appear on several rows; an entry of more than
# one letter is an ending (ch, sh).
# vowel        a vowel letter: counts a syllable group, and never doubles
# no_double    a final letter that never doubles before -ed/-ing (w, x, y)
# sibilant     an ending that takes -es (plural and third person)
# verb_es      a further ending that takes -es in the third person only
# silent_e     the letter a silent e is written with
# y_letter     the letter that turns to -ie before -s/-ed
# qu_lead      the first letter of the digraph that counts as one consonant
# qu_follow    the second letter of that digraph, read as a consonant
